episodes.synopsis: During his father’s funeral, Shogo hears a voice outside his window claiming to be his little sister, before he has a chance to learn more, he is told the conditions of his inheritance.
episodes.title: The Voice of My Unfamiliar Little Sister

episodes.synopsis: After the mysterious phone call the person claiming to be his sister, Shogo school life gets more hectic with the arrival of a new transfer student.
episodes.title: My Sister and the Moonlit Dance

episodes.synopsis: The question of Shogo's sexual preference is causing Miyabi and Rinka to go overboard on showing the appeals of a woman.
episodes.title: My Sister's Seduction

episodes.synopsis: Shogo has ruined his relationship with Miyabi; after letting Konoe know about his secret, a new problem has arisen.
episodes.title: My Sister's Hero Is Her Onii-sama!

episodes.synopsis: He thought it was over but his little sister keeps calling. Shogo discovers someone else has the same prototype phone as Konoe.
episodes.title: My Little Sister Won't Let Me Sleep

episodes.synopsis: Lyrical Sisters is on the verge of shutting down, Shogo puts together and executes a plan worthy of the Mikadono name.
episodes.title: My Neko-mimi Maid Sisters

episodes.synopsis: Using the school broadcast system, Shogo’s “sister”, has requested he stops looking for her or she will reveal damaging secrets.
episodes.title: My Little Sister Is Disciplined and Beautiful!

episodes.synopsis: Kunitachi might be the Shogo’s sister but he can’t get close to her. Ikusu suggest that Shogo and Kunitachi spend time outside the school to have her drop her guard.
episodes.title: My Sister Resisted

episodes.synopsis: Shogo is getting a new neighbor and an unexpected surprise.
episodes.title: Surprise Attack! Little Sister Warning!

episodes.synopsis: When all of Shogo’s potential wives are invited to the same party, things do not go as planned. Especially when he finds a trusted member is planning to overthrow his inheritance of the company
episodes.title: My Blooming Sisters

episodes.synopsis: With all the lies, conflicting stories, and people trying to ruin his inheritance, Shogo is breaking down. To add to his worries, Kannagi is making outrageous demands.
episodes.title: My Sister's Trap

episodes.synopsis: With the help of Ikusu, Shogo has finally put the clues together on who his real sister is.
episodes.title: My Sister Was Always Beside Me
